name: deploy-surface-contract-fixes
title: fix(api/cli): /api 404 信封、缺失静态资产 404、CLI 未知线程退出与连接泄漏（票 5cr）
description: 继续本地部署功能测试（部署面）发现 4 个问题：1) 未匹配的 /api/* 返回空 body 404（前端会当网络错误），改为 ApiResponse 信封 ERROR_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND；2) SPA 兜底对缺失 /assets/* 回退 index.html（浏览器把 HTML 当 JS），改为 404；3) CLI status/logs/resume 对未知线程显示 completed/空日志且 exit 0，改为明确 线程不存在 + exit 1；4) logs/resume 用 compile_graph_dev 不关闭，aiosqlite 连接线程让进程在解释器退出时挂死（status 用 dev_graph 所以不挂），改为 async with dev_graph。另扩展 scripts/functional_smoke.py 的部署面检查：openapi/docs、index 引用的静态资产全部 200、未知 api 路由信封、405、gzip、CORS preflight（HTML 不再截断到 400 字符）。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-03 (second half of the local-deployment functional test: the deployment surface rather than the workflow). Four real defects found by probing a live instance: (1) an unmatched /api/* route answered 404 with an empty body and no Content-Type, which the frontend classifies as a network error and thereby hides proxy/base-path mistakes; a StarletteHTTPException handler now returns the ApiResponse envelope with a new ERROR_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND code for /api/* paths, keeps the default {detail} shape elsewhere, and leaves 405 distinguishable. (2) The SPA fallback served index.html (HTTP 200, HTML) for missing /assets/* files, so the browser executed HTML as JS; missing assets now raise 404 instead of falling back. (3) CLI status/logs/resume rendered an empty checkpoint snapshot as 'completed' / blank logs with exit 0, so a typo or a wrong checkpointer looked like a finished workflow; a shared _require_existing_thread guard prints an explicit '线程不存在' panel and exits 1. (4) logs and resume compiled the dev graph without closing it, and the aiosqlite worker thread kept the interpreter alive in threading._shutdown (confirmed with faulthandler; status escaped because it used the dev_graph() context manager); both now use 'async with dev_graph() as graph:'. The functional smoke script gained check_deployment_surface: valid /openapi.json (117 paths), /docs 200, every /assets/* referenced by index.html must be 200 (the earlier HTML body truncation at 400 chars caused a false negative and was fixed), unknown /api route must be a 404 envelope, 405 on wrong method, gzip and CORS preflight. Live run: 16 checks, 15 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip (no credentials). Tests added: api route envelope 3, smoke surface 3, CLI unknown-thread 3. Docs: deployment.md lists these deployment-surface contracts. Verification: targeted suites green, ruff, mypy, full suite in the journal.
